name: Alumina Grodny
original_name: アルミナ・グロドヌイ
source:
"Rem... I, once again, have caused trouble for you. I wonder how I can repay this favor."

She's a main character, Misha's mom. Her husband, Count Hueria, died three years ago. Raising Misha and managing Glia, she's admired for her caring leadership. After losing her territory in a coup, she feels powerless against rebels. With her maid Orié's guidance, she escapes Glia with Misha, heading to Altani. A gentle silver-haired woman from East Raidnel, she's also known for her alluring figure. Unaware of her charm, she shares a long friendship with the protagonist, inviting him to her daughter's birthday at the mansion.
